author: Ash

copy.intro: You've found the Stay Cold tee with the back print you want, then seen that it ships from Germany and takes 10 to 14 working days to reach the US. The tees also start at $49 and pass $90 for the acid-washed heavy cuts. The brands below put tattoo, horror and occult art on tees too, and the American ones all sit under $49. The closest on price come first.

bodies.killstar:
Killstar is the nearest to Stay Cold on price, with men's tees from $50 to $60, and it calls its own line occult couture. Start with The Worst In Me T-Shirt ($55), or go up to one of the $60 Boxy T-Shirts, which carry artwork on the sleeves as well as the front.

If you buy Stay Cold's oversized cuts, the boxy ones are the closest shape here. They're 100% cotton jersey, and most of the range reaches 4XL, a size beyond Stay Cold's 3XL.

The catch is the wait. Its US orders go out from a hub in the EU, with delivery in 7 to 14 business days, so it's no faster than Stay Cold. And you get 14 days to register a return. If you'd rather pay less for tattoo art, Sullen tops out under $49.
bodies.disturbia:
Disturbia is the pick if you shop women's sizes, and its full-price graphic tees come from its collab with The Witcher. The Lace Up Oversized T-Shirt ($57) carries a Yennefer graphic hand-drawn by the brand's own designer.

It's a British gothic brand with its own US store, and that store says duties and taxes are included, so no customs charge lands on top. Sizes run US 2 to 16 rather than XS to 3XL. The Lace Up Shrunken T-Shirt ($54) is the fitted baby-tee version, with a wolf medallion print.

Nearly every other tee in its range is marked down, so the full-price choice is small. Free US delivery starts at $175. For a wider pick of full-price dark tees, BlackCraft Cult is the place.
bodies.sullen:
Sullen is the one to choose for the tattoo art itself. A working tattoo artist drew each of its graphics, and the tees cost $25 to $48.95. The 6 Swords Standard ($27.95), a hooded figure carrying a load of blades, shows the tarot side of the range.

The last word in each tee's name tells you what it's printed on. Standard is the entry body, Premium adds about $4.50, and 1-Ton is the heavyweight, like the Taste 1-Ton ($38.95). That's the one to set against Stay Cold's 250GSM Heavy Oversized tees at $69.

It's a Southern California label, and it goes up to 5X, two sizes past Stay Cold, with a few dollars added on the largest sizes. Spend $99 and US shipping is free, with 30 days to send anything back.
bodies.blackcraft-cult:
BlackCraft Cult is the budget way into dark, occult prints. Nearly every tee is $35, $14 under Stay Cold's cheapest, and nothing goes above $40. The Lilith T-Shirt ($35) and the Love Me Like My Demons Do T-Shirt ($35) show where the artwork goes.

The tees are a classic unisex fit in 100% ring-spun cotton, so think regular rather than oversized. Sizes run S to 3XL, the same top size as Stay Cold. Free US shipping starts at $125, which four tees will clear.

Sale items can't be returned, so stick to full price when you're unsure of a size. If you want heavier cotton, Sullen's 1-Ton tees are the step up.
bodies.black-market-art-company:
Black Market Art Company is the cheapest here, with men's tees from $25.95 to $33.95, each printed with a design licensed from the artist who made it. The Horror House Men's Tee ($27.95), with art by Grant Us Night, is a good one to start with.

The useful detail is the hang tag. Every garment comes with the artist's name and contact information, so you can follow up on a print you like. That's the same artist-first idea behind Stay Cold's collabs, for well under its $49 entry price. The styles run from traditional American tattoo to Day of the Dead and black and gray.

The tees are made and screen printed in the USA, and every US order ships free. A size exchange ships back to you free too. Sizes stop at XXL, though, so go to Sullen for 3XL and up.

closing.heading: How to choose
closing.body: Start with what drew you to Stay Cold. If it's the price bracket and the occult artwork, Killstar is closest, with boxy tees at $50 to $60. If it's the tattoo art, Sullen and Black Market Art Company both work with the artists behind their prints, and both cost less: Sullen tops out just under $49, Black Market under $34. Need a bigger size? Sullen goes to 5X and Killstar to 4XL. BlackCraft Cult is the easy $35 tee in a regular fit. And if you wear women's sizes, Disturbia's Witcher tees are the full-price option, with duties already included on its US store.

faqs.q: Where is Stay Cold Apparel based?
faqs.a: Berlin, Germany. Orders ship from its warehouse in Germany, and US deliveries take about 10 to 14 working days. Its US storefront charges in dollars, with tees from $49 to $91.
faqs.source_query: where is stay cold apparel based

faqs.a: It's run by MASCANI GmbH, a company listed in Berlin's commercial register, and it publishes a 30-day return policy for unused items. You pay the return shipping, so check the size chart before you order.
